nodes.name: AdminNotificationController.java
nodes.summary: Admin notification REST controller exposing broadcast, targeted send, listing, and administrative deletion operations through NotificationService.

nodes.name: NotificationController.java
nodes.summary: User notification REST controller for listing read and unread notifications, counting unread items, marking notifications as read, and deleting user-owned notifications.

nodes.name: NotificationRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying notification title, message, type, target type, and target id for admin-created notifications.

nodes.name: NotificationResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO that projects Notification entities into API-facing notification data including read state, type, target metadata, and creation time.

nodes.name: Notification.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity representing a notification addressed to a user with title, message, read flag, type, target metadata, and creation timestamp.

nodes.name: NotificationTargetType.java
nodes.summary: Enum defining the domain object types that a notification can point to, such as orders, promotions, products, or reviews.

nodes.name: NotificationType.java
nodes.summary: Enum classifying notification intent as system, order, promotion, product, or review events.

nodes.name: NotificationRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for notification queries, unread counts, recipient-scoped deletion, admin listing, and bulk mark-as-read updates.

nodes.name: NotificationService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining user and admin notification workflows for retrieval, read-state updates, deletion, broadcast, and targeted delivery.

nodes.name: NotificationServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Notification service implementation coordinating current-user lookup, repository queries, DTO mapping, broadcast fan-out, targeted delivery, and admin deletion behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Spring transactional service methods with repository-derived queries and builder-based JPA entity creation.

nodes.name: AdminNotificationController
nodes.summary: Groups admin notification endpoints and delegates broadcast, targeted send, listing, and deletion behavior to NotificationService.

nodes.name: broadcastNotification
nodes.summary: Creates notification records for all users from an admin request and persists them in bulk.

nodes.name: sendNotificationToUser
nodes.summary: Creates and saves one notification for a specific recipient resolved by user id.

nodes.name: getAllNotifications
nodes.summary: Retrieves paged notifications for the current user or admin-facing controller path.

nodes.name: deleteNotification
nodes.summary: Deletes a notification after resolving the applicable recipient or admin authorization context.

nodes.name: deleteAllNotifications
nodes.summary: Deletes all notifications for the current user or all notifications for admin workflows.
